exposure: Therapeutic hypothermia (TH) for moderate-to-severe Hypoxic Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE)
outcome: Extent of HIE on brain magnetic resonance imagings
Requirement for nasogastric feeding at discharge
cohort: The study included all 59 infants undergoing therapeutic hypothermia for moderate-to-severe hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy over a 3-year period (January 2020-December 2022) at a single center.
finding: Persistent pulmonary hypertension (PPHN) was diagnosed in 17% of infants undergoing therapeutic hypothermia (TH), and it was not significantly associated with short-term outcomes including extent of HIE on brain MRI, in-hospital mortality, or requirement for nasogastric feeding at discharge.
